title: spec/02a:336 Pseudocode OnMissedSuperframe ignores SYNCED state missed-beacon transition
description: Section 2a.6.2 FSM table defines SYNCED->DESYNCED transition on '>3 missed beacons'. Section 2a.6.6 pseudocode provides OnMissedSuperframe() but it explicitly ignores SYNCED state: 'IF State != RECOVERING THEN RETURN State'. There is no procedure for handling missed beacons in SYNCED state. Implementers have no algorithm for this required state transition. Fix: Add OnMissedBeacon() procedure that tracks missed_beacon_count in SYNCED state and transitions to DESYNCED when threshold exceeded.
